faq.a: Waseem is associated with the Arabic form وَسِيم, whose core sense is waseem; handsome, good-looking.

faq.q: What is the origin of Waseem?
faq.a: Waseem is associated with Arabic. Waseem is Arabic وَسِيم (Wasīm), meaning 'handsome, good-looking'.
Yes — the underlying form وَسِيم is Arabic.
Waseem can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Waseem should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Wasīm is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Waseem mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Waseem is rendered وسیم and carries the sense وسیم، خوبصورت.

faq.q: What does Waseem mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Waseem is rendered وسیم and carries the sense وسیم، خوش‌سیما.
A romanized syllable approximation is wa-seem. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Waseem?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Waseem, waseem. Script forms are وسیم, وَسِيم, वसीम.

faq.q: Is Waseem a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
